name: v1_01_wall
action: He talks to the camera with open, relaxed hand gestures, then glances at the wall around him.
line: You've saved hundreds of reels of places.

name: v1_02_orbit
action: He glances left and right with curiosity as if things are flying around him, then back at the camera.
line: Rooftop bars, dumpling spots, that cafe.

name: v1_03_vertigo
action: He stays completely still, deadpan, looking straight into the camera.
line: And you've been to none of them.

name: v1_04_dm
action: He glances up toward his left shoulder, then back at the camera, and makes a small tossing gesture with one hand.
line: So just send them all to me.

name: v1_05_check
action: He raises one finger, then two fingers, then three fingers, without saying any numbers out loud.
line: Save the reel. Send it to me. That's it.

name: v1_06_plan
action: He talks to the camera calmly with relaxed hands.
line: I turn them into a day-by-day plan, built around your reels.

name: v1_07_route
action: He turns half toward the wall behind him and points to three spots on it from left to right.
line: Day one: this cafe, then the garden, then dinner here.

name: v1_08_cafe
scene: Vertical 9:16 Instagram Reel shot on an iPhone. WHO sits at a wooden table in a cosy cat cafe in the former French Concession of Shanghai, a fluffy ginger cat next to his latte; he smiles and strokes the cat, soft window light, handheld but steady.
action: No dialogue, he does not speak.

name: v1_09_cover
action: He lifts his chin slightly and looks straight into the camera with a confident small smile.
line: Your trip.

name: v1_10_cta
action: He leans forward toward the camera and reaches both open hands toward the lens, energetic.
line: Send me your saved reels. Comment REEL and I'll send you the link.

name: s2_1_hold
action: He holds one open hand out beside his shoulder, palm up, as if presenting something floating next to him, glances at it, then looks back at the camera.
line: This Shanghai trip was built from ten reels I saved.

name: s2_2_check
action: He raises one finger, then two fingers, then three fingers, without saying any numbers out loud.
line: Save reels. Send them to me. Get this back.

name: s2_3_orbit
action: He glances left and right with excitement as if things are flying around him, then back at the camera.
line: Food spots, rooftop bars, hidden cafes.

name: s2_4_route
action: He turns half toward the wall behind him and points to three spots on it from left to right.
line: All on a map, in the right order, with tips.

name: s2_5_cover
action: He lifts his chin slightly and looks straight into the camera with a confident smile.
line: Your reels. Your trip.

name: s2_6_cta
action: He leans forward toward the camera and reaches both open hands toward the lens.
line: Comment REEL.

name: s3_1_offer
action: He leans forward toward the camera and reaches both open hands toward the lens, energetic.
line: Send me your saved reels. I'll plan your whole China trip.

name: s3_2_wall
action: He glances around at the bare wall behind him as if it is covered in things, then back at the camera.
line: All those places you saved and forgot.

name: s3_3_dm
action: He glances up toward his left shoulder, then back at the camera, and makes a small tossing gesture with one hand.
line: Share them to my DMs.

name: s3_4_plan
action: He talks to the camera calmly with relaxed hands.
line: And get back a day-by-day plan, built around them.

name: s3_5_tips

name: s3_6_cta
action: He points down toward the bottom of the screen, then looks back at the camera with a smile.
line: Comment REEL and I'll show you how.
